prompt: Some people argue that a growing number of young people spend too much time watching television. Why does this phenomenon happen? And what kind of activities should be encouraged to them?
essay:
It is often argued that an increasing number of young people spend excessive amounts of time watching television. This trend can be attributed to several factors, such as the easy availability of entertainment and a lack of alternative activities. However, young people should be encouraged to participate in sports, creative hobbies and social activities instead.

One major reason for this phenomenon is that television provides an easy and convenient form of entertainment. After studying or working for several hours, many young people prefer to relax by watching movies, television shows or online programmes. Furthermore, the widespread availability of streaming services has made entertainment accessible at any time. Another contributing factor is the lack of recreational facilities in some communities. When young people do not have access to affordable sports centres, libraries or community programmes, they may spend more time at home watching television. In addition, some busy parents allow their children to watch television because it keeps them occupied while they complete their own responsibilities.

To reduce excessive television viewing, young people should be encouraged to take part in more active and productive activities. For example, schools and parents can motivate them to participate in sports such as football, swimming or cycling, which can improve their physical health and teamwork skills. Creative activities, including reading, painting, playing musical instruments and cooking, should also be promoted because they can develop useful skills and stimulate creativity. Moreover, joining clubs or community groups can help young people build friendships and improve their communication skills. By providing these alternatives, parents and schools can help young people develop healthier lifestyles.

In conclusion, young people watch too much television mainly because it is an easily accessible form of entertainment and because they may have limited alternatives. Therefore, they should be encouraged to participate in sports, creative hobbies and social activities that can benefit their physical, mental and social development.
